title: Final Expedition Verification & Scientific Handover
subtitle: Verifying Phase One Records and Preparing the Outpost for the Next Crew
description: Conduct the final verification of the Phase One Mars expedition. Review the existing records, evidence, observations and operational information collected during SOL 1 through SOL 9. Visit the relevant existing outpost sections and inspect their registered physical interaction points. Identify whether each applicable record is consistent, incomplete, inconsistent or requires further investigation. Review the individual SOL reports, compare related scientific records, preserve the relationships between scientific targets, soil samples, cultivation experiments, environmental and emission-control records, and equipment records. Finally, prepare and submit a comprehensive Phase One Final Expedition Report for the incoming astronaut and future expedition operations.

prerequisites.description: SOL 1 through SOL 9 must be completed according to the existing campaign progression.
Previously collected mission records, observations, evidence and individual SOL reports must remain accessible for final verification.

missionZones.purpose: Review relevant existing Habitat records, personal mission records and any applicable operational information. Only inspect records that are registered and relevant to the Phase One handover.
Access the central expedition archive, inspect individual SOL reports, review verification progress, compare records and prepare the final expedition report.
Verify scientific observations, selected targets, soil sample provenance, laboratory findings and cultivation records using existing displays and records.
Verify existing engineering, equipment, water-system, power and other operational records that are relevant to the Phase One expedition.
Use existing navigation and access routes to reach the relevant outpost sections. Do not create new interaction points.
Inspect only if an existing SOL 1–9 record or registered SOL 10 verification requirement explicitly references an Airlock-related record.
Inspect only if an existing scientific observation, environmental record or registered verification item requires an outdoor record review. No new field expedition is required.

SOL10_RECORD_VERIFICATION.location: Existing registered physical interaction points defined by the operating-system trigger registry
SOL10_RECORD_VERIFICATION.description: A SOL-specific verification view that opens from each existing relevant physical trigger. It must display only the records associated with that actual trigger, screen, SOL and task, while allowing the player to review the original record and record a separate verification result.

recordResolution.source: Persisted MissionManager records keyed to the active triggerId, source SOL, taskId, and evidence references

verificationStatuses.label: Verified
verificationStatuses.description: The player reviewed the original record and confirmed that its available information is consistent.

verificationStatuses.label: Flagged for Review
verificationStatuses.description: The player identified a discrepancy, inconsistency or issue that requires attention.

verificationStatuses.label: Incomplete
verificationStatuses.description: The available record is insufficient to complete verification.

verificationStatuses.label: Not Applicable
verificationStatuses.description: The record or verification field does not apply to the associated SOL/task.

verificationRules: Opening a screen does not automatically verify its records.
The player must review the actual record before submitting a verification result.
Verification must not modify or overwrite the original observation.
A flagged record must remain visible in the archive and final report.
An incomplete record must not be silently marked verified.
Not-applicable must be used only when the actual record schema or task context supports it.
Do not require every registered trigger to be visited unless it is explicitly relevant and mandatory.
Repeatedly opening a screen must not create duplicate verification records.
Verification must be idempotent for the same record and verification state.

SOL10_FINAL_REPORT_WORKSPACE.description: A report workspace that compiles the actual SOL 1–9 mission records and SOL 10 verification results into a structured scientific expedition handover document.

tasks.title: Verify Existing Outpost Section Records
tasks.objective: Visit the relevant existing physical interaction triggers associated with SOL 1–9 records. Open each applicable existing OS screen and inspect the records associated with that specific trigger, screen, SOL and task. Identify consistent records, discrepancies, missing information and incomplete records.
tasks.completionCondition: All applicable mandatory verification items discovered from the actual project configuration have a persisted verification state. Unrelated triggers are not treated as mandatory.

tasks.title: Verify Scientific Targets and Observations
tasks.objective: Review the scientific targets selected during the earlier SOLs and compare them with the actual observations and evidence collected during the expedition.
tasks.completionCondition: The existing target identities, related observations and evidence references have been reviewed and their verification states persisted.

tasks.title: Verify Soil Sample Provenance and Cultivation Records
tasks.objective: Review the SOL 3 scientific target, the corresponding SOL 6 soil sample and the separate cultivation records. Confirm that the original target, collected sample and cultivation experiment remain correctly linked.
tasks.completionCondition: The target-to-sample-to-cultivation relationship has been reviewed using actual persisted record identifiers. Original records remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Verify Environmental, Emission-Control and Equipment Records
tasks.objective: Review the relevant environmental, emission-control, equipment and engineering records that were actually generated during SOL 1–9. Identify verified, flagged, incomplete and not-applicable records.
tasks.completionCondition: All applicable records in these categories have a persisted verification state, with unsupported or absent measurements left unfilled.

tasks.title: Perform Cross-SOL Record Comparison
tasks.objective: Compare related records from different SOLs using their actual identifiers and documented relationships. Review changes, consistent findings, discrepancies and unresolved differences.
tasks.completionCondition: All required comparisons are based on explicitly related records and include their source SOL, task and evidence references.

tasks.title: Review Verification Results and Outstanding Issues
tasks.objective: Review the verification dashboard. Inspect all flagged, incomplete and not-applicable items and confirm that their statuses accurately reflect the source records.
tasks.completionCondition: The verification summary is persisted and all outstanding issues are visible before report finalization.

tasks.title: Generate the Phase One Final Expedition Report
tasks.objective: Generate a structured report summarising SOL 1 through SOL 9, their individual activities and records, scientific targets, soil samples, cultivation, environmental and emission-control information, equipment status, cross-SOL comparisons and SOL 10 verification results.
tasks.completionCondition: A report preview has been generated from authoritative persisted records, with source references, verification states and data limitations.

tasks.title: Prepare the Incoming Crew Handover
tasks.objective: Prepare a practical handover for the incoming astronaut. Summarise what has already been investigated, which records and targets are important, which systems have been checked, what remains unresolved and what should be investigated next.
tasks.completionCondition: The incoming crew handover section is included in the report and is based on verified records and explicitly documented limitations.

tasks.title: Submit the Phase One Final Expedition Report
tasks.objective: Review the final report, confirm its completeness and submit it through the existing Mission Control report workflow.
tasks.completionCondition: The final report submission event is validated and persisted. The original SOL 1–9 records and progress remain unchanged.

report.title: PHOBOSIA Phase One — Final Scientific Expedition & Crew Handover Report
report.audience: Incoming astronaut and future Phase Two expedition personnel
scientificReportingRules: Generate every SOL summary from its actual persisted mission records and original report.
Keep SOL 1, SOL 2, SOL 3 and all other SOL reports separately accessible.
Do not merge all SOL data into one untraceable summary.
Every important finding must retain its source SOL, task and record reference.
Preserve the SOL 3 target to SOL 6 soil sample relationship.
Keep soil sample records separate from cultivation records.
Keep cultivation, environmental, emission-control, equipment and scientific target records independently identifiable.
Do not invent scientific measurements, trends, observations or conclusions.
Distinguish NASA-derived source data from simulated gameplay telemetry and fictional story events.
Clearly identify verified findings, observations, interpretations, recommendations and unresolved questions.
Preserve flagged and incomplete records in the final report.
Do not silently convert missing or unknown information into verified information.
Do not overwrite original SOL 1–9 reports or evidence.
The report must be reproducible from the same authoritative source records.
incomingCrewRequirements: Explain what the previous expedition investigated.
Identify the scientific targets selected and their current status.
Identify soil samples collected and their original target provenance.
Summarise cultivation experiments separately from soil collection.
Identify verified systems and outstanding issues.
Recommend which records the incoming astronaut should inspect first.
Identify investigations that should continue during Phase Two.
Clearly distinguish confirmed results from unresolved hypotheses.
finalizationRules: Show all flagged and incomplete verification items.
Allow the player to inspect outstanding items.
Do not mark the report fully verified if mandatory verification items remain incomplete.
If flagged issues are allowed to remain at submission, preserve them visibly in the report and handover.
Use the existing report persistence mechanism where available.
Do not introduce a separate document-management subsystem unless the existing architecture requires it.

verificationRules: A record can be verified only after it has been reviewed.
A flagged record does not automatically block report submission if the existing mission policy permits documented unresolved issues.
Incomplete mandatory verification items must remain visible and must not be silently marked complete.
Not-applicable records must be excluded from applicable verification totals.
The final report must accurately state whether the expedition handover is fully verified or contains outstanding issues.
